title: Prospective conductivity-tolerance sweep
question: How tight must the conductivity interpolation error be, while leaving the derivative-consistent theta/C representation unchanged, for all 12 F-AHL10 material-regime cases to satisfy the frozen Richards fidelity gates?

frozen.capacity: derived from the same cubic-Hermite retention interpolant

selection_rule: Select the loosest prospectively tested log(K) tolerance for which all 12 cases pass every frozen F-AHL10 gate. Do not interpolate a threshold from failed/passed values within this work unit.
